description: This file defines a base class for unit testing WebAudioPlayer components, including mock objects and helper methods for setting up test scenarios.

classes.name: WebAudioPlayerTestBase
classes.description: A base class for WebAudioPlayer unit tests, providing setup, teardown, and utility methods for testing WebAudioPlayer components.

methods.name: ~WebAudioPlayerTestBase
methods.description: Destructor for cleaning up test resources.

methods.name: createWebAudioPlayer
methods.description: Initializes the WebAudioPlayer instance and mocks.

methods.name: destroyWebAudioPlayer
methods.description: Cleans up and destroys the WebAudioPlayer instance.

methods.name: mainThreadWillEnqueueTask
methods.description: Sets expectations for enqueuing a task on the main thread.

methods.name: mainThreadWillEnqueueTaskAndWait
methods.description: Sets expectations for enqueuing a task and waiting for its completion.

methods.name: getBufferAvailableSuccess
methods.description: Mocks a successful buffer availability check.

methods.name: writeBufferSuccess
methods.description: Mocks a successful buffer write operation.

methods.name: expectWriteStoredFrames
methods.description: Sets expectations for writing stored frames.

methods.name: expectWriteNewFrames
methods.description: Sets expectations for writing new frames.

methods.name: expectStartTimer
methods.description: Sets expectation for starting a timer.

methods.name: expectCancelTimer
methods.description: Sets expectation for canceling a timer.
